resources.string: Healthy reads your health and fitness data from Health Connect and shows it on one dashboard. It reads only — it never writes anything back. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account, no cloud and no analytics: the data never leaves this phone.
Your watch and your scale write to Health Connect through different apps, and no app shows you both. Healthy reads the lot and puts it on one screen.
No account, no cloud, no analytics.
The data never leaves this phone.
Healthy never writes to Health Connect.
Health Connect will ask which of these Healthy may read. You can allow some and refuse others — anything you refuse is simply left off the dashboard.
This phone can also grant access to data older than 30 days. Without it, Healthy sees only the last month of anything your watch or scale wrote.
This phone\'s Health Connect cannot grant access beyond 30 days, so Healthy will show the last month only.
Healthy has nothing to read without it. Health Connect is the phone\'s own store for health data — installing it does not send anything anywhere.
The version on this phone is older than the one Healthy reads through.
No app store on this device to install it from.
